name: Gandhar Oil Refinery
tagline: Light research entry - Confluence-100 rank 82 (Gandhar Oil Refinery)
verdict_headline: Light entry pending full deep-dive research
verdict_reasoning: Conviction Low-Medium assigned via Confluence methodology

commitments.text: Sustain gross margin spread of Rs 28,145/kl (Q1 FY27 exceptional level) for 1-2 more quarters
commitments.specifics: Q1 FY27: Rs 28,145/kl spread (vs Rs 8,274/kl Q1 FY26). Management: 'hopeful of margins remaining at this level or around this level' for most of the year, with sustenance for 1-2 more quarters
commitments.dependency: Geopolitical situation (Middle East) and supply chain normalization
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Resumption of normal crude/base oil flows from Middle East; Hormuz Strait reopening

commitments.text: 8-10% annual volume growth (historical and forward guidance)
commitments.specifics: Q1 FY27: volume +8% YoY (131,000 kl vs 121,000 kl); management confirmed '8-10% volume growth historically and anticipated for this year'
commitments.source: Gandhar Oil Q1 FY27 concall, screener.in
commitments.dependency: Continued demand from PHPO (personal care, pharma) and export markets
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Slowdown in personal care or pharma demand

commitments.text: PHPO (personal care/health care/performance oil) to remain primary growth driver; PIO (process & insulating oil) strong secondary
commitments.specifics: Q1 FY27: PHPO +18% YoY, PIO +28% YoY. Management: 'PHPO continues to be our primary growth engine'; expects continued strength in both categories
commitments.dependency: Customer retention and new customer qualification (4,000+ existing customer base)
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Loss of major PHPO or PIO customer

commitments.text: Export business growth and expansion to South Africa/new geographies
commitments.specifics: Q1 FY27: export volumes +54% YoY, contributing 51% of revenue. South Africa entry being worked out; clarity in next 1-2 quarters
commitments.dependency: Geopolitical risk (AGOA extension, tariffs), logistics normalization
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Tariff reversals or trade restrictions on exports

chain: Global/Middle East base oil supply disruption (geopolitical)
Agile sourcing: switch to South Korea, domestic suppliers at opportunistic prices
Margin spread expansion: Rs 8,274 → Rs 28,145/kl (3.4x YoY)
PHPO +18%, PIO +28% growth on steady volume base
PAT Rs 26 cr → Rs 206 cr (+688% YoY, highest quarterly profit ever)
Debt-free balance sheet, 100% interim dividend declared
earnings_chain.bottleneck_link: Geopolitical normalization and margin reversion to historical 5-8% EBITDA range (current 16.2% is peak cycle)
earnings_chain.operating_leverage: yes -- Q1 showed explosive operating leverage off base-oil sourcing skill; volume-agnostic growth as margins drive earnings
evidenced_links: Q1 FY27: revenue +92% YoY to Rs 1,732 cr, PAT +688%
Volume growth: 8% YoY (121-131 kl) = margin, not volume story
assumed_links: Gross margin spread sustains at Rs 28,145/kl for 1-2 quarters (management guidance)
Margin normalizes to 6-10% EBITDA range (historical average) in H2 FY27+
PHPO and PIO growth rates (18% / 28%) repeat

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: 8.1x P/E on Q1 FY27 PAT (Rs 206 cr quarterly annualized Rs ~824 cr) implies market is pricing a dramatic margin reversion. Realistic trajectory: Q1 margin (16.2% EBITDA) → Q2 sustained → H2 normalizes to 7-10%
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: FY27 PAT: Rs 350-400 cr (vs Rs 137 cr FY26, +155-190% growth driven by high Q1 + normalized margin path Q2-Q4)
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: FY28 PAT: Rs 280-320 cr (volume +8-10%, margin normalized to 7-9% EBITDA, no geopolitical premium)
market_expectation.gap_basis: 8.1x trailing P/E on Rs 206 cr quarterly profit (peak-cycle quarter) assumes immediate margin normalization to near-zero; even conservative 7-9% EBITDA run-rate warrants 12-15x multiple on normalized earnings
market_expectation.data_caveat: Current P/E from Yahoo Finance Oct 2, 2026; management cautious on 'sustaining margins' for '1-2 quarters', implying half-year visibility; historical CRISIL industry margin 5-8% used as normalization anchor

catalyst.event: Q2 FY27 margin print (Oct 2026) - sustain Q1 FY27 profit momentum (692% YoY growth to ₹206 Cr); refining margin cycle validation

four_box.note: FY26 PAT +64% YoY (Rs137cr), ROCE 10.8%->13.5% (screener/company results); Q1FY27 PAT +689% YoY on gross-margin spread (Rs28,145/kl, 3.4x YoY) but volume only +7.8% YoY - spread/price driven not TAM expansion. 26.5% India/9.6% global white-oil share = narrow real moat in a commodity-adjacent blending business. P/E ~8.1x on Rs2,549cr mcap despite the earnings beat -> valuation=yes; un-ignorable Q1 growth = written exception keeping 10x-in-2-3-years live at 2.0-2.5 band.
